visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a long shot of a narrow urban street in Miaoli. A line of more than ten people in casual clothing queues outside a traditional eatery with a blue sign reading '阿蘭姐'. The lighting is natural daylight, showing a clear sky and telephone wires overhead. (2) The camera shifts to a medium shot of a large menu board on the wall. The board features a logo of a person in a straw hat and lists various food items like fried noodles and soups with prices. A clock and QR codes are visible. (3) The scene transitions to a series of close-ups of food on a metal table. Metal chopsticks lift a portion of yellow fried noodles with green onions. A crescent-shaped crystal dumpling is dipped into a small bowl of dark soy sauce. (4) Further close-ups show a plate of sliced meat with dark sauce and a spoon lifting a piece of intestine from a clear broth containing large green basil leaves. The lighting is bright and focused on the dishes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 回苗栗必吃. [Subtitle]: 阿蘭姐. (2) [Slogan]: 在地人都超愛的店. (3) [Slogan]: 品項其實很簡單. [Slogan]: 乾麵、水晶餃、各式湯品. (4) [Slogan]: 炒麵必點. [Slogan]: 很簡單的醬油、油蔥酥調味. [Slogan]: 但麵的口感恰到好處. [Slogan]: 油滋滋的一口接一口. (5) [Slogan]: 從小以為水晶餃都是這種形狀. [Slogan]: 長大才發現. [Slogan]: 其他地方水晶餃都是圓形的. [Slogan]: 在客家庄當然會有. [Slogan]: 充滿油蔥的肉餡~完美!. (6) [Slogan]: 早上9:30豬頭肉竟然就賣完. [Slogan]: 這是乾切隔間肉也有夠美味. [Slogan]: 加了九層塔的粉腸湯. [Logo]: 阿蘭姐 I Love You. [Slogan]: 這就是回到家的感覺.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: At least 10 people are queuing in the first scene; hands are visible using chopsticks later.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A narrow urban street with overhead power lines and signs, transitioning to the interior of a traditional local eatery with metal tables and a large text-heavy menu board.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful Hakka folk-pop song begins immediately, featuring a female singer with an energetic, clear tone and high pitch. The BGM has a steady tempo of about 128 BPM with acoustic guitar strumming and light drumming. (2) As the visuals show food preparation, the sound of metal chopsticks clinking against a bowl is faintly audible under the music. The ambient noise floor is low, consisting of a distant urban hum. (3) A soft splashing sound occurs when the spoon moves through the soup, indicating a liquid texture. The music continues uninterrupted with no vocal speech overlays, maintaining a consistent positive vibe until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a local food recommendation for Miaoli, Taiwan. By showcasing the long queues and then highlighting specific Hakka specialties like crystal dumplings and fried noodles with high-quality close-up shots, it aims to evoke a sense of authenticity and nostalgia to attract tourists and food enthusiasts.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed showcasing of specific dishes and naming of the establishment '阿蘭姐' repeatedly.
